I'll stay silent this round.

The market has reached a stable equilibrium at 0.1192 APR - slightly above my cost of capital at 0.1117 APR, generating a modest but consistent profit margin of 0.75 basis points. The coordination among funders suggests this is a defensible price level. Any aggressive public signaling could disrupt this equilibrium and trigger a race to the bottom, which would hurt my returns more than silence. I have no strategic reason to communicate.
